title: Asset Provenance and Licensing Metadata
description: Schema for tracking the origin, license, and modifications of assets.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier for the asset (e.g., filename or hash).

source.description: The origin of the asset (e.g., 'Gemini Asset Factory', 'Unsplash', 'Internal Design Team').

author.description: The creator or original author of the asset.

license.description: The license under which the asset is used (e.g., 'CC-BY-4.0', 'Proprietary', 'MIT').

modification_date.description: The date and time the asset was last modified or processed.

notes.description: Any additional context, such as AI generation prompts or specific processing steps applied.
